newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins quiet as market eyes holidays.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins quiet as market eyes holidays.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds were little changed on Monday in a quiet market ahead of year-end holidays and awaiting market-moving news, dealers said.
"A Russian bank sold its client's papers but the day has been otherwise dead," Mosbiznesbank dealer Igor Potapov said.

Another dealer said the market was likely to remain in the doldrums until next year but prices could benefit if Russia adopts a budget for 1997. Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin is due to present a revised budget draft to parliament on Friday.
"But there is no good or bad news for the market at the moment," he added.
